input.title: Missing Lexeme after quickly deleting a thought
input.body:
## Steps to Reproduce

```
- a
  - b
    - c
- cc
```

1. Import the text and then refresh the page (so that `c` is buffered). 
2. Set the caret at the end of `cc`.
3. Quickly hit Backspace twice. 
4. Set the cursor on `a` to expand it and load `c`. 

## Current Behavior

The Lexeme for `c` is missing, as indicated by the grey bullet.

When `cc` is edited to `c`, it triggers a call to `getLexemeById` from thoughtspace.ts. Then when `c` is deleted before its Lexeme has loaded, it overwrites the Lexeme contexts, causing the `a/b/c` context to be incorrectly deleted. 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a10ab977-3e61-449d-a1ed-7794f900c06f

## Expected Behavior

The Lexeme for `c` (which originally had two contexts) should have a single context left. i.e. The Lexeme for `a/b/c` should not be missing and the bullet should not be grey. 

## Testing

Create an integration test. You may need to stub the response time of the `getLexemeById` call.
